QuestInfo.name: [Madhouse] Dark Record
QuestInfo.0: Where did that kid with the weird eyes come from? And why did they destroy the madhouse?
QuestInfo.1: You can collect 6 pages of the Secret Shadow Diary by hunting monsters in your level range. Collect all the pages to complete the Secret Shadow Diary.
QuestInfo.2: The kid with the strange eyes... You should learn more about this mysterious figure.
